coordination_onset_exponent.provenance: Excess coordination above isostatic scales as Delta_z = z - z_iso ~ (phi - phi_c)^(1/2): O'Hern et al. 2003 PRE 68:011306 (Eq. 6 / Fig. 9), confirmed across potentials, polydispersity, and dimension. Universal exponent 1/2; not fitted.

dimension_d.provenance: Physical space dimension d=3. Enters the isostatic coordination z_iso = 2d.

phi_c.provenance: Onset-of-jamming packing fraction phi_c for 3D frictionless spheres ~ random close packing ~0.639: O'Hern, Silbert, Liu & Nagel 2003, Phys. Rev. E 68:011306 ('Jamming at zero T and zero applied stress'). At phi_c the bulk AND shear moduli simultaneously become non-zero. Bernal 1960 / Scott & Kilgour 1969 give RCP~0.6366. FRICTION and POLYDISPERSITY shift phi_c down (frictional ~0.55-0.58) -- which is exactly why the ABSOLUTE biological value is graded [O], not this universal anchor.

rigidity_coordination_exponent.provenance: The rigidity that emerges CONTINUOUSLY at the transition (the shear modulus, which vanishes at phi_c) is set by the excess connectivity above isostaticity: G ~ Delta_z (linear in excess contacts): Wyart, Nagel & Witten 2005 EPL 72:486; Liu & Nagel 2010 Annu. Rev. Condens. Matter Phys. 1:347. Composing with Delta_z ~ (phi-phi_c)^(1/2) gives the continuous rigidity onset ~ (phi-phi_c)^(1/2).

unit_bulk_modulus_pa.provenance: [O] Single-cell elastic modulus E ~ 0.1-10 kPa varies by cell type and method (AFM nanoindentation, optical-tweezer/optical-stretcher, micropipette aspiration): Hochmuth 2000 J. Biomech. 33:15; Guck et al. 2005 Biophys. J. 88:3689. A generic 1 kPa central placeholder stands in; the per-cell-type MEASURED modulus is the named obstacle. Absolute B-flow is [O].

unit_density_kg_per_m3.provenance: Mammalian cell mass density ~1.03-1.10 g/mL (slightly denser than water): e.g. Grover et al. 2011 PNAS 108:10992 (suspended microchannel resonator). Generic central value; used only as the density anchor of the ladder. The DIMENSIONLESS softening ratio does not depend on it.

z_isostatic.provenance: Maxwell isostatic coordination z_iso = 2d = 6 in 3D (Maxwell 1864 counting argument; exact). At the jamming point the packing is marginally rigid with z = z_iso (O'Hern et al. 2003).

unit_wave_speed_m_per_s.provenance: c0 = sqrt(B0/rho0); FORM exact (VP master), absolute [O] because B0 is [O]

z_iso_equals_2d.provenance: isostatic identity z_iso = 2d checked against the DB

ladder_rungs.name: cell
ladder_rungs.provenance: Typical animal cell diameter ~10-20 um (Alberts, Molecular Biology of the Cell). Generic central value.

ladder_rungs.name: organ
ladder_rungs.provenance: Organ scale ~ cm. Generic central value.
